core_categories: Medical Devices; Health Technology; Regulatory Affairs; Distribution; Clinical Research Management
specialty_focus: BioD Medica is a Malaysian-based healthcare technology and medical device commercialization company. It acts as a one-stop solution provider handling product registration, regulatory affairs, importation, warehousing, clinical research management, and distribution for advanced medical devices in Malaysia and Singapore. It distributes wearable medical devices such as EKG systems and portable ultrasound devices.
